evals.prompt: Send 0.01 SOL to 7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU on Solana devnet using my Turnkey wallet.
evals.expected_output: Working TypeScript code that initializes TurnkeyClient and TurnkeySigner, creates a Connection to devnet, fetches a fresh blockhash, builds a SystemProgram.transfer transaction, calls signer.signTransaction(tx, solanaAddress), then connection.sendRawTransaction and confirmTransaction. Logs the transaction signature.

evals.prompt: I need to batch send SOL to three different addresses using my Turnkey wallet: 7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU, 9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM, and DYw8jCTfwHNRJhhmFcbXvVDTqWMEVFBX6ZKUmG5WUSHI. Send 0.001 SOL to each.
evals.expected_output: Code that builds an array of transactions (one per recipient), each with a fresh blockhash, then calls signer.signAllTransactions(transactions, solanaAddress). Sends all signed transactions via connection.sendRawTransaction and confirms each. Logs all signatures.

evals.prompt: Sign the message 'Hello from my Turnkey agent' with my Solana key.
evals.expected_output: Code that encodes the message with TextEncoder, calls signer.signMessage(messageBytes, solanaAddress), and logs the resulting signature bytes (Uint8Array). Includes full client and signer setup.
